verdict.rationale: Supabase ships an official CLI. The docs cover project setup (`supabase init`, `supabase start`) and local development with schema migrations captured for version control, and a runtime probe confirmed `npx -y supabase --version` runs keylessly from npm (v2.117.0). Missing for 10: documented agent-oriented CLI behaviour (machine-readable/JSON output, non-interactive auth for agents), and independent hands-on reports of agents driving the CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: With two commands, you can set up and start a new local project: 1. supabase init to create a new local project, 2. supabase start to launch the Supabase services
Develop locally using the CLI to run a local Supabase stack... then capture your changes in schema migration files, which can be saved in version control.
the official Supabase CLI ran keylessly from npm — `npx -y supabase --version` printed `2.117.0` with no account or login.
